resources.string: Sign in with an SQL Server user and password. Azure AD (Entra) sign-in and Windows authentication are not supported.
The database is the one the connection opens; the app lists its schemas. To work in another database, add another connection.
Separate statements with a semicolon. The GO batch separator is a client command and is not supported.
The SQL Server driver ignores the read-only setting. The app still refuses the writes it can recognise, but the real protection is the server: sign in with a user that only has SELECT permission.

Without SSH, this phone connects to SQL Server directly. That only works where the server\'s port (1433 by default) is reachable from the phone\'s current network; Azure SQL also needs the phone\'s address allowed in its firewall.
Without a CA certificate the connection is verified against the certificate authorities your phone trusts, which is what Azure SQL needs.
